issues.description: The table renderer crashes with TypeError whenever a report has zero rows.
Ingest writes valid rows to SQLite before rejecting files whose malformed-row ratio exceeds 10%.
Rows with missing cells produce None values and crash with AttributeError instead of being counted as malformed.
Upserts blindly overwrite existing jobs, so importing an older snapshot can revert completed or failed jobs back to stale states.
Report filters compare timestamp text lexicographically, which gives wrong results for mixed ISO formats or timezone offsets.
Timestamps are validated but stored unnormalized, allowing semantically equivalent times to sort and filter inconsistently.
Failure reporting only matches exact FAILED, TIMEOUT, and OOM states, so alternate out-of-memory or suffixed state values are ignored.
GPU parsing sums every gres/gpu* TRES entry, which can inflate GPU-hours if aggregate and typed GPU entries both appear.
Negative GPU counts are accepted, allowing negative GPU-hour totals in reports.
Ingest only handles RowParseError, so unreadable files, decode errors, and parser type errors surface as uncaught tracebacks.
The malformed-threshold test asserts the nonzero exit but misses the database side effect caused by partial ingestion.
